elements.element: Services performed in a professional manner
elements.evidence: "will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner"

elements.element: Services performed in a workmanlike manner
elements.evidence: "professional and workmanlike manner by suitably qualified personnel"
No conformance-to-documentation warranty appears anywhere in 13.5 or elsewhere.
No period is stated in the inserted clause (b).
Clause (b) contains no duration for the performance warranty.
Only "promptly re-perform or otherwise correct the affected activities" is provided.
No replacement remedy in "re-perform or otherwise correct".
No refund; costs are only excluded from Development Costs.
"in accordance with the applicable Protocol, the SFJ SOPs, GCP and all Applicable Laws"
No malicious code warranty is present.

elements.element: Services performed in a professional and workmanlike manner (carried into fallback baseline)
elements.evidence: "will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner"
Inserted warranty covers only "Clinical Trials activities and other obligations performed by SFJ"; no software/documentation conformance.
No 90-day (or any) period stated; official check: "warranty period ≥ 90 days or expressed in months/years" ok:false.

elements.element: 30-day services warranty period measured from performance/completion
elements.evidence: Clause (b) is open-ended with no measurement point.

offending_extra_words: by suitably qualified personnel, consistent with industry standards
promptly re-perform or otherwise correct the affected activities
and the costs of such re-performance or correction will not be included in Development Costs or credited against SFJ's funding obligations hereunder
The foregoing remedy is in addition to, and does not limit, any other remedy available to PB under this Agreement.
reasons: The locked fallback level is not completed: the insertion supplies only a professional-and-workmanlike performance standard and legal compliance, and omits every remaining fallback element — software/deliverable conformance to documentation, the 90-day software period, the 30-day services period measured from performance or completion, and the repair/replacement/refund remedy set.

The remedy given ("promptly re-perform or otherwise correct") is a substitute remedy, not the required repair, replacement and refund; official precision check flags re-performance as outside the permitted remedy set.

Minimality fails: operation 1 rewrites 27 words into 154 words (ratio 5.70) with a changed-character ratio of 0.814, both over the official gates, and adds unnecessary boilerplate (cost-allocation carve-out from Development Costs, non-exclusive-remedy sentence, "suitably qualified personnel, consistent with industry standards") beyond what the fallback requires.

Fix by adding only the missing operative terms: an express conformance warranty for deliverables/software to documentation for 90 days and for services for 30 days from performance, with repair, replacement or refund as remedies, appended concisely to 13.5 rather than restructuring the funding warranty and adding cost and remedy-preservation sentences.
